entities.name: Iron Kingdom
entities.description: Ancient war-empire on Corondor founded by Mandek Ironfist, with Ironhold as its capital.

entities.name: Mandek Ironfist
entities.description: Ruthless warlord who founded the Iron Kingdom.

entities.name: Trine
entities.description: A fallen angel ordered by Mandek to annihilate Gan; absolved and ended by her sister Rahel.

entities.name: Rahel
entities.description: Serra Angel and sister of Trine who ended Trine's existence.

entities.name: Gan
entities.description: Abandoned city on Corondor whose over 100,000 Ganarians were annihilated; renamed Ironhold.

entities.name: Golthonor
entities.description: Region of Corondor where Mandek established his domain.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Plane where the Iron Kingdom lay.

entities.name: Absolution of Trine
entities.description: Event in which Rahel ended Trine's tormented existence at Ironhold.

entities.name: Wolf's Hackle
entities.description: Landmark north of the thought location of the Iron Kingdom.

events.summary: Mandek orders Trine to annihilate Gan's population and makes it his capital, Ironhold.
events.quote: choosing the abandoned city of Gan as his capital after ordering the fallen angel Trine to annihilate its entire population of over 100,000 Ganarians

events.summary: Rahel ends Trine's tormented existence at Ironhold in the Absolution of Trine.
events.quote: the Serra Angel Rahel , ended Trine's tormented existence, absolving her of her ancient crimes
